tool_args.rationale: The ten observations span substrate and subcritical sink gradient, allowing numerical fitting of the recalled saturating base mechanism. Its extrapolation above the avalanche threshold remains unidentifiable, so fresh confirmation is needed.

considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: All paid observations lie below the reported threshold, so its onset and strength cannot be fitted from these data; the requisite high-gradient probe is not in the available menu.
The wide-gradient observations and saturating pilot favor the recalled sink-gradient mechanism; confirmation will test that choice.
The trajectory batch has already been acquired, and the nuisance probe is irrelevant.
